title: Interaction Context Often Increases Sycophancy in LLMs
reasoning: The paper includes a significant evaluation component centered on moral judgments. It utilizes the 'Am I the Asshole' (AITA) dataset to measure 'moral endorsement' (agreement sycophancy) and specifically evaluates the models' ability to replicate or affirm moral judgments in personal advice scenarios. It also discusses 'moral mimicry' and 'moral foundational biases' as part of its theoretical framework.
